about.title: About the Sheikh
about.placeholder: Sheikh Nour Eddine Al-Meslati is a Libyan reciter who recites the Holy Quran in the Qaloon 'an Nafi' narration — the narration used in Libya and long established in Msallata, the city his name is attributed to.
bio: Sheikh Nour Eddine Al-Meslati is a Quran reciter from Libya. He is attributed to the city of Msallata, known for the memorisation of the Quran and for reciting it in the Qaloon 'an Nafi' narration.

He recites the entire Quran in the Qaloon 'an Nafi' narration — the reading of Imam Qaloon from Imam Nafi' of Madinah — which is the narration adopted in Libyan mushafs and used in its mosques and Quran schools.
This khatmah includes all 114 surahs, offered here for listening and free download, retaining the original recording quality without any modification.
To follow new recitations, you can visit the Sheikh's channel on Telegram.
